paite: Huan Jerusalem a Rehoboam atuntouh in, Israelte dou a, Rehoboam gam la nawn ding in Judah nuaikhat leh Benjamin inkote, mihangsan chiat telkhiak, nuaikhat-le-singgiattak akaikhawm hi.
heading: Shemaiah Genkholhna / (1 Kum 12.21-24)
english: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

paite: Himahleh Pathian mipa Shemaiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: But Yahweh’s word came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

paite: Judah gam kumpipa Solomon tapa Rehoboam kiang ah leh Judah gam leh Benjamin gam a Israel mi tengteng kiang ah,
english: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

paite: "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: na hohtou ding uh ahi kei, na unaute uh dou sam kei un; na inn lam uah pai nawn vek un; hiai keimah hih ahi hi, chi in gen in," chi in. Huchi in TOUPA thu amang ua, Jeroboam dou ding a ahoh ding uh akik nawn uhi.
english: ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is of me.”’” So they listened to Yahweh’s words, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

paite: Rehoboam bel Jerusalem ah a-om a, Judah gam ah kivenna ding in khua asat hi.
heading: Rehoboam In Khopite Kulhbaang In A-um
english: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.

paite: Bethlehem khuate, Etam, Tekoa asat a,
english: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,

paite: Beth-zur, Shoko, Adullam,
english: Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam,

paite: Gath, Mareshah, Jip,
english: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,

paite: Adoraim, Lakish, Azekah,
english: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,

paite: Zorah, Aijalon, Hebron khua; huaite Judah leh Benjamin gam a kulh nei khopite ahi.
english: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.

paite: Huchi in huai kulhte ahihkip a, heutute akoih a, nek ding, thau leh uain asekkhawm hi.
english: He fortified the strongholds and put captains in them with stores of food, oil and wine.

paite: Kho teng ah lum leh tei akoih a, khua kiptak in abawl chiat hi. Huchi in Judah leh Benjamin gam ama gam ahisak hi.
english: He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.

paite: Huan Israel gam tengteng a siampute leh Levite amau gam a kipan chiat in akiang ah ahong uhi.
heading: Siampute Leh Levite Judah Ahong Uh
english: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory.

paite: Levite'n agam uh leh a-omnate uh apawtsan ua, Judah gam leh Jerusalem ah ahoh uh; Jeroboam leh atapate'n TOUPA a dia siampu nna sem lou ding in atawpsak uhi.
english: For the Levites left their pasture lands and their possessions, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office to Yahweh.

paite: Amun sang a ding leh keltal leh bawngnou lim abawl a ding a siampute aseh zawk ziak in.
english: He himself appointed priests for the high places, for the male goat and calf idols which he had made.

paite: Huan Israel nam, TOUPA Israel' Pathian lam a lungsim awn tengteng in azui ua, TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian kiang ah kithoih ding in Jerusalem ah ahoh uhi.
english: After them, out of all the tribes of Israel, those who set their hearts to seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.

paite: Huchi in Judah gam akipsak ua, kum thum sung Solomon tapa Rehoboam in akipsak hi: kum thum sung David leh Solomon lampi azui uhi.
english: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years, for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.

paite: Rehoboam in David tapa Jerimoth tanu Mahalath zi in anei a, huai Jesse tapa Eliab tanu ahihleh Abihail tanu ahi.
heading: Rehoboam Inkuante
english: Rehoboam took a wife for himself, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse.

paite: Tapate aneihsak a: Jeush, Shemariah leh Zaham ahi uh.
english: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

paite: Amah nung in Absalom tanu Maakah anei a; ama'n Abijah, Atai, Ziza leh Shelomith aneihsak hi.
english: After her, he took Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

paite: Rehoboam in Absalom tanu Maakah bel azite leh amite tengteng tung ah a-it tuan a; zi sawm-le-giat leh mei sawmguk anei a, tapa sawmnih-le-giat leh tanu sawmguk anei ahi.
english: Rehoboam loved Maacah the granddaughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

paite: Rehoboam in Maakah tapa Abijah, a-unaute lak ah makai lianpen in abawl a; kumpipa ding a bawl alungsim ahi zomah hi.
english: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, the prince among his brothers, for he intended to make him king.

paite: Piltak in agamta a, atapate tengteng Judah gam leh Benjamin gam tengteng kulh nei khopite ah a-om zaksak vek a; nek ding tampi apia a, zi tampi azonsak chiat hi.
english: He dealt wisely, and dispersed some of his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city. He gave them food in abundance; and he sought many wives for them.
